scope: Temporary macOS main-thread native Cocoa callback -> common protected input -> actual Backend/Front/Editor. Composition and maximum commit borrow output without additional String allocation; 200 warm direct-callback/pop/consume events check one decoded String allocation per event, not GUI input latency; recreated-view and closed-challenge rejection, five release-before-free event scrub checks, actual context/external-retain/autorelease cleanup. Auth module is enabled and unused visual modules disabled only in temporary harness; no changes to backend/editor behavior. Excludes C/ObjC/OS/RSS, stacks and preinitialized shared budget/thread/clock/framework state. No window, actual IME keystrokes, SSH/helper, viewport review or input-to-presentation claim.
